scope: All currently ACTIVE Shopify products, product-owned variant counts, two exact channel-publication booleans, published locales; no product bodies, variants, translations, customer data or Merchant API.

coverage.variant_count_method: Sum Product.variantsCount.count over unique ACTIVE product IDs; every Count precision EXACT. Variant IDs, individual status/availability and Merchant offers were not enumerated.
coverage.atomicity: Not an atomic transaction across API calls. Complete unique product enumeration matches exact server count in this bounded read.

prior_market_evidence.meaning: Configuration only; does not prove Google country/language selection, shipping, translation quality or product eligibility.

product_language_pair_arithmetic.meaning: Arithmetic only, excluding country expansion. Neither count is a Merchant feed denominator or proof that these localized records exist.

decision.shopify_bulk_publication_fix: NO_ACTION_NEEDED; exact missing scope0/240 for both Online Store and Google & YouTube
decision.immediate_next_action: Root verifies Merchant513542500 connection/data source, Google & YouTube Countries and Languages selection against these21 published locales and supported intended markets, then captures synced/pending/disapproved offer counts and exact reasons.

decision.no_readiness_claim: ACTIVE and Shopify channel publication are prerequisites, not accepted Merchant offers, translation completeness, stock/shipping eligibility, paid activation or profitable performance.
